ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low white-to-black ratio; predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) localized clusters accounting for approximately 10% of total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation across the total visible area. High-contrast geometric blobs include a series of circular rings on the upper-mid left lobe, parallel linear streaks on the upper-left quadrant, and irregular white mottling on the distal right tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a sharp interior angle approximately 50-60 degrees; depth of depression is significant relative to total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency serrations visible; minor peak-and-valley variations along the trailing edge boundary, with higher frequency of micro-notches on the right lobe edge compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-modal curve; initial concave sweep from the median notch transitioning into a broad convex curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly distinct spatial clusters of circular high-contrast rings (barnacle scars) located on the mid-left and mid-right lobes; approximately 6-8 prominent rings on the left and 3-4 on the right.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of approximately 5-7 parallel, high-contrast vertical linear marks (rake marks) on the upper inner portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks on the left fluke lobe and multiple circular barnacle attachment scars distributed across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized area of high-intensity white pixel mottling at the extreme edge of the right lobe tip.
